description: Traceability matrix of section 13.5: fixtures to contracts to tests to milestones. Two checks in InterCat.Architecture.Tests keep it honest.

fixtures.title: Seeded two-process TCP loopback exchange
fixtures.scenario: Section 13.1 scenario 1: TCP IPv4 loopback, several connections, several messages per connection.

truth.independence: Both processes write their own log from ordinary socket calls; neither reads InterCat state.

expected.note: The expected query bundle and its canonical hash are defined by IC-018. This milestone records measured counters and the inputs they came from.

environment.result: All six section 14.2 criteria met; the tier stays ExperimentalEvidence because the build is outside the section 1.3 matrix.

provenance.contents: Fixture-scoped loopback observations and truth records only. Unrelated whole-machine flows are never written (P16).

tests: R8: a capture moves Idle to Recording to Closed and reports its own counters
P14: a capture never adopts or stops a session it did not create
P16: persisted fixture evidence excludes unrelated whole-machine endpoints
I14: one admitted record cannot satisfy two truth operations

fixtures.title: Seeded two-process named-pipe exchange in message mode
fixtures.scenario: Section 13.1 scenario 3: named pipe in message mode with a deliberately short read, so requested and completed sizes differ.

truth.independence: Both processes write their own log from ordinary pipe calls; neither reads InterCat state.

expected.note: A measured negative result: the tier is Unsupported, and the control count is part of the expected artifact because it is what makes the negative trustworthy.

environment.result: 0 of 25 truth operations observed through Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-File, with 2,472 control records from the same processes in the same capture. Tier Unsupported; scope decision recorded in ADR-003.

provenance.contents: Truth logs, scenario parameters and the measurement counters. Raw file observations are not committed because they carry unrelated machine paths (P16).
